title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Price Schedule Note: Rack Rate on the Alignment Correction Fee
content:
The rack rate on the correction fee of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is **0.80** where the order's source is a network customer-pay repair that is still open (opened, in repair or awaiting approval), **0.90** where its source is a network customer-pay repair that is ready, delivered or closed, and **1** otherwise.

The rate acts on the tier's alignment correction fee itself, and the rated correction fee is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Records the rate is read from

The calibration order's recorded source and, where the source is a network customer-pay repair, the status of that Customer-Pay Repairs order.

| Status of the source customer-pay repair | Rack rate on the correction fee |
|---|---|
| opened, in repair or awaiting approval | 0.80 |
| ready, delivered or closed | 0.90 |
| the order's source is not a network customer-pay repair | 1 |

## Illustration (hypothetical correction fee of 129.95 USD)

- Source customer-pay repair awaiting approval: 129.95 multiplied by 0.80 is 103.96 USD.
- Source customer-pay repair closed: 129.95 multiplied by 0.90 is 116.955, rated at 116.96 USD (half up).
- Order opened after a glass replacement: rate 1, the fee stays 129.95 USD.
